# `aube node`

- **Usage:** `aube node [ARGS]…`

Run Node.js through aube's project runtime resolver

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube node --version
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-runtime) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`[ARGS]…`** — Arguments to pass to Node.js

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
